summary: Shows the security problems that come from allowing overlapping fragments in IPv6, and updates the base IPv6 specification to explicitly forbid them. Receivers must handle such packets as the document describes. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: If puzzle pieces overlap in strange ways, an attacker can trick you about the picture. This document says that IPv6 pieces must not overlap, closing a loophole for sneaky traffic.

questions: why are overlapping fragments a security risk
